newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's state airliner traffic up 6.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's state airliner traffic up 6.2 percent.

text.p: Jordan's state carrier Royal Jordanian (RJ) saw a 6.2 percent rise in passenger traffic in the first nine months of 1996 compared to the same period last year, its planning department said on Monday.
Royal Jordanian carried 984,050 passengers over the nine month period and passenger seat factor was 67 percent against 65.4 percent in the same period last year.
Total cargo during the nine-month period rose 6.1 percent to 51,463 tonnes compared to the same period last year.
Traffic was markedly higher on the U.S, European, Far East, Indian and Canadian routes, the airline said.
Its 17 plane fleet flew a total of 47,970 hours compared to 45,283 hours the same period last year, a rise of six percent.
